title: Thoughtful Thermo Snake
author: starwarigami
rules:
A Thoughtful Thermo Snake wants to spend the afternoon contemplating the exhibits at the Sudoku Variant Museum. It enters the museum through one of the 4 exits (Corners) and wants to visit every exhibit (Box) exactly once, before leaving the museum by a different exit).

The snake consists of a single path of orthogonally connected cells that never touches itself orthogonally (diagonally is fine).

Within each box, the snake passes through at least 2 cells, and the digits along its path within the box increase in the direction of travel.

Solve the sudoku such that there exists a unique path for the snake through the museum.

All standard variant rules apply.

Puzzle Link

Museum Guide

• Exhibit 1: Arrows. Digits along an arrow sum to the number shown in the attached circle.

• Exhibits 2 and 9: Kropki Dots. Digits separated by a white dot must be consecutive. Digits separated by a black dot must be in the ratio 2:1.

• Exhibit 3: German Whispers. Digits along the green line must differ by at least 5.

• Exhibits 4 and 8: XV. Digits separated by a V sum to 5. Digits separated by an X sum to 10.

• Exhibit 5: Renban. Digits along the pink line must form a set of consecutive digits, in any order.

• Exhibit 6: Dutch Whispers. Digits along the orange line must differ by at least 4.

• Exhibit 7: Killer Cages. Digits within the cage must sum to the indicated total.
